name: autodev-app
//: private: this dir builds the DESKTOP APP, it is not the npm package. Publishing it would ship a package with no out/ (gitignored, so `main` points at nothing), no bin, and electron only as a devDependency — it installs fine and does nothing. The published `autodev-app` package is npm/ — a launcher that fetches the release artifact.
description: AutoDev desktop app — manage autonomous AI agents
author: Peter Ivanov <peter@microweber.com>

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.pack: npm run bundle:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run bundle:cli && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle:cli && npm run build && bash scripts/build-win.sh
